Home.title:
Code with AI,
and understand every step.
Home.intro: Start with a change you can finish in ten minutes: say what should change, give just enough context, then check the result yourself. The judgment stays with you.
Home.stepOneBody: Shrink “make it better” into one change you can see.
Home.stepTwoBody: The relevant files, constraints, and one example beat the whole project.
Home.stepThreeBody: Read the diff, click through, run the checks — don’t just take “done” from the AI.
Home.courseIntro: Each lesson is one complete loop. Finish it, then try it in your own project.
Home.stepOneExample: “Change the main button label to Start learning. Keep the click behavior.”
Home.recordBody: Completion marks and your last position are saved on this device and never uploaded.
Home.languageTitle: Five languages, reviewed lesson by lesson
Home.languageBody: English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · Français · Español. Every language version of a lesson shares one completion mark.
Home.privacyBody: No analytics scripts. One functional cookie remembers your language.

About.title: Learn at your own pace
About.intro: Learning AI Coding is a free reading space for people learning to work with AI on code. You do not need an account to read.
About.storage: Completion marks and your last lesson stay in this browser, on this domain. Translations of a lesson share the same mark. Clearing browser data or changing devices or domains may remove access to these records. They are not sent to our server.
About.languages: The interface is available in five languages. Lessons are published separately after review, so availability varies. A functional cookie remembers your language choice; explicit language URLs work even when cookies are blocked.
About.privacy: There are no advertising or analytics scripts. External links lead to other services with their own policies. The hosting provider may keep ordinary access logs. Never paste private keys or sensitive project information into public examples.
